title: AWS and OpenAI announce multi-year strategic partnership
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
OpenAI and AWS have entered a multi-year, $38 billion partnership to scale advanced AI workloads. AWS will provide world-class infrastructure and compute capacity to power OpenAI’s next generation of models.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/aws-and-openai-partnership).
